pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Animation must show her refusal first, followed by cable/earpiece returning to LEFT pocket rather than disappearing. Coat edge spills toward D in this candidate; keep one coat on C and reconcile this visibility with GUIDE12/13 in final cut.

pairs.observed: Two distinct cups are held before: blue-band in anatomical LEFT hand, cream in RIGHT. After both stand independently on table, blue leftmost/nearer B, cream rightmost; hands visibly empty, he leans with full shoes still in frame.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Cup order reverses between frontal hand layout and table layout. Require sequential placement with visible contact/release and coherent crossed-body reach; two simultaneous straight descents would silently swap cup identities. Table is toward room right; later interaction must respect actual reach distance. Its leg partly obscures a boot, so this source does not prove all foot contacts. No extra cup or autonomous placement.
